What is a Ball of Goof?

apps.name: Banker: Tidy Up the Bank Vault
apps.short_description: Banker: Tidy Up the Bank Vault is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 16,000 scattered banknotes and coins. Put the vault back in order at your own pace, right down to the last coin.

apps.name: Banner Age
apps.short_description: Banner Age is a real-time strategy game set in a medieval fantasy world. Build your army, advance through the ages, and strengthen your forces through the talent tree. Battle an online opponent or a bot, defend your banner, and destroy the enemy’s.

apps.name: Barista Dream - Prologue
apps.short_description: Open your own cozy cafe for free. Brew every drink by hand, pour your own latte art, and read what customers post about you on an in-game social network.

apps.name: Base Matter
apps.short_description: A 3D material simulation sandbox for building machines, running experiments, and seeing what happens.

apps.name: Bazaar Below Zero
apps.short_description: Don Morsa has kidnapped you. Time to get to work! Mine ice, uncover frozen items and sell them to seals in this incremental co-op game for 1–4 players. Organize your bazaar, upgrade your tools and hire penguins. Explore the glacier’s secrets as you plot your escape.

apps.name: Bermuda Trial
apps.short_description: Party Based Autobattler RPG where you choose team of three survivor to explore  the wonders and dangers of the procedurally generated maps of Bermuda Island.

apps.name: Beyond Krukmore
apps.short_description: A turn-based dice-building roguelite where your weapons and spells are the dice you roll. Lead two heroes and a companion through a dark fantasy world, piece together powerful builds, and weigh the promise of better loot against the cost of one more fight.

apps.name: Bilingual Crosswords
apps.short_description: Learn languages by solving crosswords. Solve crosswords → encounter new words → review with spaced repetition → repeat → learn.

apps.name: Blast Project
apps.short_description: A 2D action platformer inspired by the old greats like MegaMan X and Contra. Battle your way through the robot horde, with classic platformer levels and high speed shoot-em-up style stages

apps.name: Blood Banner
apps.short_description: A world without limits. Strive for your own ambitions, achieve them in any way you deem fit. Go out and embark on an adventure, set out to build an empire, settle and hone your craft - it's up to you. Your new life is a legend waiting to be written...Spawn in a new world.

apps.name: Bone Jours Tale
apps.short_description: A cheerful skeleton pulls himself together, fights the dead who refuse to stay down, and tries to fit in with a village that is terrified of skeletons. Step one: get his arm back from the dog. A goofy action RPG about losing bits of yourself and making friends anyway.

apps.name: Boo! Boo! Train!
apps.short_description: A cozy train journey through a valley that keeps its own time. Drive slowly, pick a line at every junction, stop for the view and whistle at the neighbours. One real hour is one day in Pinewind Valley, and the season turns every week. Nothing to build, nothing to fail.

apps.name: Boomside
apps.short_description: A roguelike twist on Minesweeper. Dig up houses, signal towers and parks for points, chain power plants into huge multipliers, and read every hint to steer clear of the gas mains. Hire helpers, build your combo, and secure all eight key sites to redevelop the district.

apps.name: Bosky
apps.short_description: Escape your school, avoid being seen by the teachers, and retrieve your backpacks and other things before getting outta here.

apps.name: Bow & Banner
apps.short_description: Live the campaign of a medieval longbowman. Hunt, scout, survive and fight in brutal battles as Kaden of Bracken, mastering archery and battlefield judgment across 14 chapters, while choices, wounds and failure shape a war story with 13 endings.

apps.name: Brickin' A Toy Town
apps.short_description: Smash cubes, build adorable houses, and create the toy town of your dreams! Enjoy satisfying destruction, unlock and level up all kinds of helpers and automations. Choose a charming theme or mix and match everything to make your little world truly yours!

apps.name: Brilliancy!!
apps.short_description: Solve real chess puzzles in a roguelike where chess skill drives the score. Seat Tutors and upgrades that reward forks, sacrifices and quiet moves, beat each Set’s Target, outlast Bosses and hunt for the hidden Brilliancy. No invented pieces, no bent rules: the best chess is always rewarded.

apps.name: Bubble Dropop
apps.short_description: Bubble Dropop is a cozy puzzle game about sorting pictures and words into categories. Drag to connect matching bubbles, then swipe down to collect them. Make every move count as you solve puzzles across a variety of levels, unlock colorful backgrounds, and find your own relaxing rhythm.

apps.name: Bunny Tower
apps.short_description: Jump higher than ever! Bunny Tower is a fast arcade platformer: climb an endless tower through 8 worlds, grab coins and unlock 35+ skins with unique abilities. The higher you go, the faster it gets. One mistake and it's over. How high can you go?

apps.name: Busty Angel Paradise
apps.short_description: Hand out the divine punishment of ultimate pleasure to all 20 superbly stacked heroines! Win (or lose) sex battles in this RPG, and enjoy larger-than-life H-scenes, every one animated!

apps.name: Call of Duty: Black Ops II - Zombies
Captive Lily
apps.short_description: In this roguelike adventure, you awaken with no memory in a deadly dungeon built to contain demon kin. Fight through ever-changing floors, meet mysterious heroines, and build bonds that unlock powerful skills. Return stronger after every defeat and uncover the secrets buried deep below.

apps.name: Caramba Caballeros
apps.short_description: Caramba Caballeros is a first-person pirate roguelike for 1–4 players. Explore islands and hunt for treasure by day. Defend your ship from enemy waves by night. Battle other pirates in a battle royale, solo or in teams, with matchmaking and custom lobbies.

apps.name: Card Thunder
apps.short_description: Select cards from a 5x5 grid, stack powerful boosters and perks, and outscore escalating target scores in this spatial poker roguelike.

apps.name: Cardboard Cowboy
apps.short_description: Cardboard Cowboy, the cardboard Wild West shooter. Blast through handcrafted paper shooting galleries, dual-wield makeshift revolvers and shotguns, and chase high scores across three outlaw-filled regions. Beat timed weapon challenges. Collect tarot cards. Unlock the ultimate cardboard loadout.

apps.name: Cardboard Tanks
apps.short_description: Co-op tank roguelite for 1–4 players. Blast through a fully destructible world, online or on the couch.

apps.name: CARRRDS
apps.short_description: CARRRDS is a multiplayer pirate card game. Race your ship, sabotage the other captains, and try to be the first one home with the treasure.

apps.name: Casino Dealer Simulator
apps.short_description: You're not the gambler — you're the dealer. Run the casino's blackjack and Texas Hold'em tables: deal by hand, count the payouts, read the hands, and catch cheats before the pit boss catches your mistakes. Real-time shifts, a career from Trainee to Pit Boss, and a VIP room if you earn it.

apps.name: Castaway Collection
apps.short_description: Three classic Flash games return in one collection. Raise loyal pets, battle monsters, discover powerful equipment, explore mysterious islands, and build elemental defenses across the complete Castaway series, with more than 60 Steam achievements to unlock.

apps.name: Casus Foederis: 1815
apps.short_description: Europe, 1815. Every court watches the others. Grow too fast and the powers unite against you; break your word and no one stands by you. Lead one of twelve powers to 1871 — by recognition, by congress or by force, if you can pay the price. Turn-based, single-player.

apps.name: Cell Eats City
apps.short_description: A cursor-driven incremental game about one escaped cell. You steer, it eats: microbes, a research lab, a technician's flat, then a whole city. Mutate between short rounds, break every barrier and grow from a speck under the microscope to the size of a city. Then do it again as five other microbes.

apps.name: CheckWild
apps.short_description: CheckWild is a spatial roguelike. Place directional symbols on the board, pair them with abilities you collect along the way, and build up your score to defeat monsters!

apps.name: Cheese Panic
apps.short_description: An asymmetric co-op stealth action game: one player is the Cat, up to four are mice. Raid a house, a factory and a dungeon for food, distract the predator and haul the loot together before you get caught. Silly physics, proximity voice chat and random events in every match.

apps.name: Choking Hazard
apps.short_description: Build giant toy sets with up to 3 friends, online or split-screen. One enormous pop-up manual, no adult supervision. Argue over step 8 together, or take it slow on your own. Finish a set and watch it spring to life. In Creative mode, build your own sets and share them on the Workshop.

apps.name: Cinema Manager Simulator
apps.short_description: 🎬 Schedule movies, sell tickets, serve snacks, customize your theater, play arcade mini-games, and befriend adorable cats. Turn your cinema into the ultimate entertainment destination, alone or with friends! 🍿

apps.name: Click through Earth
apps.short_description: Click Through Earth is a short, relaxing incremental game. Gain diamond and coins. Use them to unlock items and upgrade a versatile upgrade tree. Use your own combination of items to make super powerful attacks.

apps.name: Coffee & Fox
apps.short_description:
Manage your café, meet new friends, and serve unique drinks as new stories unfold every day in Coffee & Fox!
Can you handle everything this place has to offer?

apps.name: Coffee Buns
apps.short_description: Coffee Buns is a transformation visual novel set in the world of Mice Tea. Leonardo Bianco is a barista getting used to living in a world where a magical tea can turn you into a furry, and when he gets his own chance to try it he's thrust into an erotic, gender-bending journey of self-discovery.

apps.name: Confide
apps.short_description: Create, customize, and interact. A deep character creator with hundreds of morphs, full outfit design, and control over nearly every detail down to tattoo and accessory placement, plus an optional conversation mode that runs entirely offline on your own machine.

apps.name: Coq++
apps.short_description: Build mathematical proofs like circuits. Connect facts and rules, break down puzzles, and turn the theorems you prove into tools for your next challenge. Start with the simplest connections, and unlock new proof blocks as you go.

apps.name: CorruptedZ
apps.short_description: Lead a band of survivors through a valley the dead have taken. Build a colony from salvage, keep your people fed, warm and sane, and hold your walls against the infected and raiders. Raise children, bury your dead and take back the town of Blackwater. Single-player colony survival.

apps.name: Couch Potato
apps.short_description: A collection of party games for up to sixteen people on one TV, with the phones already in your pockets as controllers. Hop on the couch, scan the code and you're in. Fight, fish, feast, hop and scrum, and unlock new weapons, arenas, pets and rods as the night goes on.

apps.name: CRASH THE PARTY
apps.short_description: Blend in. Bluff the Guards. CRASH THE PARTY is a chaotic multiplayer game where Destroyers disguise as Guests, Guards or Statues create distractions and destroy the party while avoiding capture. Guards spot suspicious players and hunt down the hidden Destroyers before chaos takes over!

apps.name: Crossbloom
apps.short_description: Defend the last gardens from waves of mutant pests in a colorful roguelite tower defense. Crossbreed living plants, expand the battlefield block by block, and shape powerful botanical builds that evolve with every run.

apps.name: D-JT: Don the Jurassic Tyrant
apps.short_description: When Election meet Extinction! Dinos ripped through space to crush President Don's election, and his Plan? Invade Dino Isekai, grab the oil, and turn every dino into an immigrant voter! Place your army, press start, and watch thousands clash in this glorious chaos mass-battle strategy game!

apps.name: Darkwood 2
apps.short_description: Roam freely around the scorched deserts of a dying sea as you secure resources and explore the mysteries of Darkwood. But beware nightfall – seek shelter, shore up your defenses, and pray for the morning light as the horrors of the world hunt the ill-prepared.

apps.name: DEATCoreBattle
apps.short_description: Hold your last bastion against an enemy with a plan. Build your economy, wall off the routes and place your defenders between waves, while an Invader Director reads how you play and picks the strategy that hurts most.

apps.name: Deep Pockets
apps.short_description: Deep Pockets is an incremental inventory management game where every ore you mine gets dropped into your pockets as a physics object. Dig deep, ferry minerals in your pockets, and get rich! But be sure to not take more than you can carry.

apps.name: Defrost Forbidden
apps.short_description: The year is 4150. You discover an old cryo facility. The sleepers are still inside, but their names are gone. Cross-reference interview tapes, newspapers and notices to identify each one and fill in their records. With every name you restore, more of what happened here comes to light.

apps.name: DELTA // SURGE
apps.short_description: In DELTA // SURGE you build an overpowered fighter and blast through waves of enemy fleets and bosses. Choose weapons and upgrades during each run, then spend your earnings on permanent upgrades and unlock powerful cards. Come back stronger and see how far your next build takes you.

apps.name: Delta Particles
apps.short_description: Delta Particles – is a total conversion mod for HL. You're playing as a technical engineer of complex "Delta Base" Nick Farrell. Unfortunately, the protagonist was in the wrong place at the wrong time, as an experiment at the Black Mesa Research Facility resulted in a resonance cascade.

apps.name: Desktop Fantasy Packs: Idle Auto Battler
apps.short_description: An idle auto-battler that lives in a small window on your desktop. Spend the gold your party earns on fantasy packs, collect hero, monster and even boss cards, and field a party of four. They fight on their own while you work. Sweep your mouse across the field to leave a trail of fire.

apps.name: Dice Showdown
apps.short_description: Turn-based strategy meets Roguelike adventure! Enjoy a mix of luck and tactics. Build a unique skill set, battle various enemies, discover powerful devices, and save the world!

apps.name: Dignaut
apps.short_description: Take on a peaceful mining mission that leads to something far more mysterious. Dig, upgrade your tools, and slowly awaken an ancient alien temple buried beneath the surface, bringing its forgotten music and light back to life.

apps.name: Doll Brawl
apps.short_description: Introducing Doll Brawl, a character action roguelike. Battle enemies, and find different abilities to change your playstyle! Upgrade abilities in the skill tree to control the flow of your build, and take down increasingly tougher foes with those upgrades!

apps.name: Don't Burn Out!
apps.short_description: A block-pushing puzzle game in corporate hell, where you must confront your boss and escape the soul-draining workplace before you literally burn out. Solve over 100 handcrafted & unique puzzles that will require you to think strategically, with each step bringing you closer to flames!

apps.name: Don't Kill Them All
apps.short_description: Orcs don’t die: THEY RAGE! Embody their Warchief and lead them out of misery in this brutish strategy game with base-building, where one Orc outburst can turn victory into disaster.  Forge bonds between units, shape their personalities, and unleash their true potential both in and out of battle.

apps.name: Dont Wake Dad
apps.short_description: Sneak, steal, and escape without waking Dad! Play solo or with up to three friends in this tense, funny stealth game. Dodge traps, hide in cupboards, upgrade your skills, and reach the getaway van before it leaves. One more valuable could cost you everything.

apps.name: Draftmaster 3
apps.short_description:
Racing is a team sport, now you're the whole team.

Seamlessly hop between roles across the race weekend, driving the car, running the strategy, through to changing the tires and scouting the field for new talent and sponsors. 

Help a friend with online co-op play, coming soon to PC and Mobile.

apps.name: DREADMINER: Millions Below
apps.short_description: Mine the depths. Expand your network. Turn the caverns into a killing ground. Build a fragile foothold into a roaring battery in this gothic steampunk sci-fi tower defense RTS, and take command when the swarm pushes your defenses to the limit.

apps.name: Drellnathor
apps.short_description: Drellnathor is a roguelite dungeon crawler where you grow stronger between runs. Kill monsters, collect loot, and slay powerful bosses for permanent upgrades. Can you discover why you're trapped in a cycle of life and death?

apps.name: Dune Mechanic : Survive The Steampunk Era
apps.short_description:
This is a game about the painstaking and gradual process of building a fully functional, 
resource-harvesting, and self-defending base in the desert from scratch. Cut, mine, dig, shoot, build, research, design, craft, explore and more in the unknown deserts!

apps.name: Duskwarden
apps.short_description: Co-op survival action RPG for up to 6 players. Hunt, forge, and cook your way across a shattered fantasy archipelago, take down colossal Wardens, and rekindle the Lumen before the world loses its next dawn.

apps.name: ECC: REDLINE
apps.short_description: ECC: REDLINE is a brand-new, self-developed extreme-sports tactical shooter from NetEase Games. It is faster, smoother, and more forgiving: every movement choice and every shot can turn the tide.

apps.name: Erehwon
apps.short_description: The gear you acquire completely transforms your party’s roles. Erehwon is a loot-driven dungeon crawler where you progress by reshaping your builds around the gear you find.

apps.name: Evil Frenzy Arena
apps.short_description: Evil Frenzy Arena is a 2D pixel art arena roguelite with bullet hell and frenetic chaos. Survive waves, unlock abilities and craft wild builds from weapons, evolutions and prototypes. It starts slow, then the enemies and bosses turn the arena into pure frenzy.

apps.name: Exchange Alley
apps.short_description: Trade shares, spread rumours, exploit bubbles and chase your fortune in the chaotic coffee houses of 18th-century London, birthplace of the modern stock market.

apps.name: Fate's Masquerade
apps.short_description: In this animated, manhwa-inspired otome, romance the princes you were meant to hate. First, earn their affection and try not to die. Then save the empire, or burn it to the ground. Fairytale romance or villainess revenge? You decide.

apps.name: Felix's bad dream
apps.short_description: Felix's bad dream is an adventure game about Felix, who wakes up in an unusual place for him and will continue to explore it.

apps.name: Fever
apps.short_description: Experience the beautiful horror of a hostile alien planet in this co-op survival FPS. Explore, mine resources, craft weapons, and fortify outposts with turrets and traps. When the sky rains blood, fight hundreds of creatures and survive the Fever.

apps.name: Fifth Tier
apps.short_description: Fast, readable football management. You don't just pick the XI — you own the club. Take a small side from the fourth tier of a five-tier pyramid towards the top: tactics, wages, stands, academy, shares. Then sell up and buy a bigger club. A whole season can be played in an evening.

apps.name: Fire Buller
apps.short_description: Throw a flaming bull from a baseball stadium as far as it goes: over the city, past the Moon and Mars, to the edge of the universe and on to 10^1000 km. Wherever it lands, it crashes and rampages. Distance times destruction buys a stronger arm and twenty wilder bulls.

apps.name: Fished Out
apps.short_description: Fish, flee, and gamble your way to quota in this 1-4 player roguelike. Fight every catch, haul it aboard, avoid demonic beasts, and make it back to the ship with just enough time to bet it all at the casino. Miss quota and the sea takes every coin. One wrong cast could cost everything.

apps.name: Fluffkin Grove
apps.short_description: A cosy pixel idle game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Hatch collectible Fluffkins, assign them to work buildings, and watch four little worlds grow while you do other things.

apps.name: Flush Draw
apps.short_description: Flush Draw puts the control in your hands. Literally. Cash out every hand and stack the deck with upgrades in a focused, hour-long sprint to finally draw a flush, then keep drawing to find all 8 endings. But be warned: the odds are against you.

apps.name: Football Story
apps.short_description: Football Story is a cozy football RPG and life sim about growing up, friendship, and a dream. Develop your skills, explore the town of Lumen Bay, help its residents, and build your own street football team. Rise from your first neighborhood matches to victory over the pros!

apps.name: FOSSILE LOADING
apps.short_description: Gather tiny creatures and lead a growing group! Strengthen their abilities, crown kings, and battle rival groups to survive. But numbers won't save you from falling meteors or avalanches—sometimes everyone has to run. How long can your creatures survive as new layers of earth pile up?

apps.name: FrameWork
apps.short_description: Your desktop IS the puzzle. Drag, stack, and arrange real OS windows to guide a marble to the goal. Physics meets window management in a puzzle game that turns your entire screen into a playground. Features a level editor, Steam Workshop, and speedrun leaderboards.

apps.name: FrogMog
apps.short_description: FrogMog is an online party night. Take your team of frogs from basketball to a race, then paintball, then horseshoes, and come back out into the Mother Tree. Game modes built to drive relaxing competition. Early Access, with a lot more on the way.

apps.name: FULLTIME
apps.short_description: Manual 6v6 football with a sky-high skill ceiling. No assisted passes, no auto-aim, no scripted touches: every pass, shot and dribble is yours. Play ranked or with friends, track your game with real football stats, and build your own player and club.

apps.name: Fungakas
apps.short_description: Fungakas is a frantic indie "all-star" party hero shooter featuring characters from different indie games and media where you can customise any character into any niche by changing its abilities, charms and special each with roomates to get the exact variants of character you need for your playstyle

apps.name: Game Dev Empire
apps.short_description: Start a game studio in 1980 and turn it into an industry empire. Build teams, create hits, follow a changing market with competitors, and expand into engines, publishing, hardware, digital stores, and acquisitions.

apps.name: Genesis: Battle of Champions ONLINE
apps.short_description: Experience the next evolution of trading card games! Genesis: Battle of Champions ONLINE combines strategic card combat with tactical movement, positioning, and spellcasting on a stunning 3D battlefield. Play all five starter decks online for FREE!

apps.name: Glory Hole Barista
apps.short_description: A short, sweet, 3D simulation game about a café with a "unique" marketing strategy! And in case you were wondering, no, you won't be serving coffee...

apps.name: Goblin Backpack
apps.short_description: Your backpack is your battle plan! In this solo strategy autobattler, equip summon cards to build and position your team. Swap weapons for power and melee or ranged combat. Choose unique priests, fit items into limited space, improve your build with battle rewards, advance the map, and fight bosses!

apps.name: Gofoot
apps.short_description: Gofoot is a fast, lightweight, and nostalgic football management game. Create your manager, build squads, compete in championships, and customize leagues, clubs, and players in a simple, addictive sandbox experience built for the community.

apps.name: Golden Survivor
apps.short_description: A Myanmar-mythology bullet heaven. Wield folkloric weapons and legendary heroes against endless waves of spirits and monsters. Auto-fire, level up, survive, alone or with friends in online and LAN co-op.

apps.name: Gorse Roll
apps.short_description: Steer a ray-traced glass marble along floating roads of ice, mirrors and spinning floors. Race the clock through five worlds, hunt hidden sun crystals to earn a sixth, then build your own courses in an editor that traces every change as you make it.

apps.name: Grandparadox
apps.short_description:
Go back through time and kill Grandad.

A co-op board game with absurd weapons used to hunt your Grandfather throughout the decades to create the ultimate grandfather paradox... The Grandparadox! Play solo with bot helpers, or with up to 9 other people in online multiplayer!

apps.name: Half-Life: Restored
apps.short_description: Previously known as Restore-Life, Half-Life: Restored is a fan made modification for Half-Life. This modification will stretch your Half-Life experience with unused, cut and retail version content from original game.

apps.name: Hana
apps.short_description: Hana is a 3D top-down tactical MMORPG where you play as a Hanari, a race of elves whose civilization has been decimated. Confront formidable adversaries solo or with your friends, develop your guild, your commerce, and rebuild the Hanaris civilization.

apps.name: Hellstorm Gunners
apps.short_description: Crew a B-17 Flying Fortress with up to 7 friends. Run between the guns, patch the damage and bomb targets over real aerial photos of Paris. Or fly the fighters, on either side. Ten modes, from bomb runs to Zombie Rain. Controller-first online co-op. Bots man the empty guns.

apps.name: HEXBANE: The Last Delivery
apps.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where a pizza delivery takes a terrifying turn. Explore a mysterious building, face unpredictable horrors, run, hide, and survive as you attempt to deliver a pizza to Apartment 13.

apps.name: Hive Fall
apps.short_description: An expansive incremental game that rewards both active and idle gameplay. Defend your planet from an onslaught of alien insects, block projectiles, purchase upgrades, collect artifacts, and complete missions for rewards. There is always something new to unlock as you progress deeper into the swarm.

apps.name: HOLD THE DOCK
apps.short_description: HOLD THE DOCK is a wave defense game with roguelite elements. Defend the dock gate. The mutants are out to smash it! Gun them down, build a loadout of weapons, modifiers and skills that activate on their own, fortify your position and keep the swarm from breaking through until the cargo arrives.

apps.name: Holtmezo
apps.short_description:
The villagers were conducting an experiment, but it went wrong and they were transformed into monsters.
You are a soldier and must clear the village of monsters.

apps.name: How Many Cockroaches Can You Kill?
apps.short_description: How many cockroaches can you kill before your stamina runs out? Before the Queen crawls out? Before the whole city is infested? Squash roaches, grab the coins, upgrade, unlock bombs, lightning and a giant slipper, and find out in this fast incremental clicker.

apps.name: Hyper Gravity
apps.short_description: A physics-based platforming challenge where you harness gravity to roll, bounce, and dribble a gravity ball through 40 handcrafted challenges. Master your momentum, find your flow, and get the ball in the goal!

apps.name: Hyperspace Neptunia: Unlimited
apps.short_description: Take flight in Hyperspace Neptunia: Unlimited, a 3D RPG where Neptune and her fellow Goddesses fight to prevent Doomsday! Explore dungeons from the ground and sky, unleash customizable combos and team attacks, and challenge colossal bosses with 11 Goddesses!

apps.name: Hypnosis of Corruption -After Story-
apps.short_description: Continue the story in Hypnosis of Corruption: After Story as Hinata and the Student Council confront new struggles after the evil Hypno's manipulation - only to be swept into a bizarre mission involving a mysterious cat and a journey back to space.

apps.name: I will not Flee
apps.short_description: Lead a nation across a contested galaxy. Build your fleet, develop planets and negotiate with rival powers, then land with your troops and fight as your commander. I Will Not Flee combines real-time strategy with direct ground combat in a single-player campaign.

apps.name: I Won't Let You Level Up In My Goblin Town
apps.short_description: Adventurers invade your goblin town to grind XP, and your strongest warrior is in Active Time Battle. He swings the sword, you are the supply line. The difference between victory and defeat is a quick potion run. Platform and sprint in this fast-paced turn-based battle interference equip-em-up.

apps.name: Idle Mind
apps.short_description: Light up a whole brain, one neuron at a time. Drag to link neurons, level them up, unlock five lobes and sleep to grow stronger. A relaxing idle game with a living soundtrack and a story to uncover.

apps.name: Incremental POP: Fishing
apps.short_description: Fish in quick rounds, spend your gold on upgrades and fuse your tools until one hoop net becomes an ocean-wide haul. Catch 30 species, pick talents, send out your Night Fleet and chase The Great Haul.

apps.name: Intergalactic Space Slugs from Space
apps.short_description: A colony survival game about soft, slow, very squishable space slugs. Build out your flying saucer, fly it across endless alien worlds, trade with the locals or fight them, and find a new home.

apps.name: Intervallo
apps.short_description: Intervallo is a single-player, first-person puzzle game with unique recording mechanics.

apps.name: Inu Bowl
apps.short_description: A dog-girl football manager about prepping players for the pro league. The draft will take your best girls, so plan ahead and keep the team winning. Titles and awards earn traits your girls keep forever, on the way to building the ultimate player.

apps.name: Jankrigged
apps.short_description: Humanity clocked out early 300 years ago, and every machine on the planet is still on shift. You're the only robot without a job. Bolt broken fridges, toilet guns and barcode scanners onto your chassis and fight back. A cartoon roguelite where every build is janky, but it works.

apps.name: Jelly Heads
apps.short_description: A tiny island of jelly heads lives in the corner of your desktop, farming Jelly while you work or study. Complete families, spin the roulette to open boxes and send your Epics through the idle Campaign.

apps.name: Jesus Christ: Necromancer
apps.short_description: This is a fast, brutal gothic metroidvania: reap the damned with the scythe, raise their bones to fight beside you, grow stronger at every shrine, and carve your way through a dead [un]holy city to the Four Horsemen. Jesus is back... and he's back for Blood.

apps.name: Jingle Janitor
apps.short_description: Your first night as Santa's janitor, and the elves partied all night. Sort a gloriously messy workshop until every toy part sits on its shelf, learn handy magic, cheer up the elves and save Christmas. Cozy first-person tidying, alone or with a friend on the couch.

apps.name: Junk & Thirst
apps.short_description: A classic real-time strategy game set in a dried-out wasteland. Build a base, harvest scrap, fight for every barrel of water and crush your rivals with tanks, buggies, rockets and gunships. Lead the Colonists or the Raiders against cunning AI generals or your friends.

apps.name: Junk Mountain
apps.short_description: One wedding ring is buried in a mountain of over 30,000 pieces of junk. Dig by hand, sweep up iron with a magnet, sell it at the scale and upgrade everything — from a backyard junkyard through a scrapyard, a port and a landfill all the way to orbit, until the junkyard runs itself.

apps.name: Just Up
apps.short_description: Get ready to jump, climb, and test your limits in Just Up! a challenging platforming adventure where every step takes you higher, and every mistake can send you falling back down. Explore an absurd world filled with unexpected obstacles, tricky jumps, and unpredictable challenges.

apps.name: Kabakura
apps.short_description: Kyabakura Wars is a kyabakura management sim with a visual novel inside. Take a club drowning in debt, turn it into the best venue in town, and defeat the four rival bosses standing between you and fame.

apps.name: Katanagari
apps.short_description: An old-school RPG built for one. Follow quests and train your skills in a handcrafted world inspired by Asian folklore, where wildlife forages and hunters stalk their prey. Explore at your own pace, prepare for danger, and find unexpected uses for five-element magic.

apps.name: Kawaii Kaiju: Beam!
apps.short_description: Bibi is a baby kaiju, and the city is her toy box. Smash towers, kick cars, swing your tail and fire a rainbow mouth beam across eight pastel stages in 90-second rampages. Chain the destruction for big scores, grab stars for wild power-ups, and dress Bibi up between rounds.

apps.name: Keeplings
apps.short_description: A creature-collector MMO. Explore open world islands, trade with other players, and engage in turn-based battles solo or duo.

apps.name: Keeplings Desktop Companion
apps.short_description: A creature-collector desktop companion. Battle and catch wild Keeplings while you work, stream or game.

apps.name: King Scribble
apps.short_description: Explore the Sketchbook World as you help navigate King Scribble back to the Doodle Kingdom! Draw platforms and objects to solve puzzles, defeat enemies, and find secrets!

apps.name: Known Variables
apps.short_description: Known Variables is a dark, choice-driven psychological romance thriller visual novel. Uncover a deadly conspiracy, pursue dangerous relationships, and decide who deserves your trust. Shape attraction, loyalty, and betrayal through choices where every secret has a price.

apps.name: Kuze Tooru Case Files: The Liar Vanishes in the Rain
apps.short_description: A small incident on a rainy night leads back to a lie told sixteen years ago. A classic whodunit with private detective Tooru Kuze and police detective Rei Narumi. Solve each chapter as a portrait ADV, unlock it as Showa-style manga, question suspects in your own words, and name the culprit.

apps.name: Lady Mature & Her Horny Bitches
apps.short_description: In Lady Mature's old mansion, you are both a guest and a victim of her experiments. Explore rooms of pleasure, solve puzzles, and meet seven maids she trained herself. A dark, erotic horror game where pleasure tests your endurance.

apps.name: Lahmacun Master: Turkish Cooking Game
apps.short_description: Run a cozy Turkish flatbread shop with a wood-fired stone oven! Roll the dough for lahmacun and pide, bake it just right and don't forget the ayran. Grow your shop, hire a team and open branches across Turkey. Cook side by side with a friend or partner in local co-op

apps.name: LIC: House Rules
apps.short_description: An adult psychological horror visual novel. Mel from next door turns up in the rain with one bag and a scraped arm, and your wife says she can stay a week. She's 21, helpful, and easy to like. Then her mother comes over to warn you about her. A week later her mother is dead.

apps.name: Light Devourer
apps.short_description: Light Devourer is a pixel-art soulslike ARPG featuring fast-paced combat, a rich world to explore, and a dark fantasy story.

apps.name: Lo and Behold
apps.short_description: Lo and Behold is a cozy tinged roguelike where you fight to protect a quirky village of animal folk. Venture out to fight corrupted beasts, use elemental powers to shape your own spells, and return with resources to rebuild and flourish Behold Village into a lively, magical home.

apps.name: Loaded Bones
apps.short_description: Loaded Bones is a poker-inspired dice roguelike where every roll can change your fate. Build powerful combinations, collect game-changing Keepsakes, unleash mystical Incantations, and chase outrageous scores as you gamble your way through a supernatural world to challenge the Devil himself.

apps.name: Lost Bitcoin
apps.short_description: Lost Bitcoin is a digging and automation game set in a gigantic junkyard. Collect scrap, burn it for coins, buy upgrades and build a factory that works for you. Crack crates and safes, and check every USB stick to find your lost Bitcoin wallet.

apps.name: Magic Store Simulator
apps.short_description:
Inherit an abandoned magic shop and bring the neighborhood back to life.

Renovate, upgrade, and customize your shop to attract more customers. Unlock new workshops and expand your product range to meet their needs.

apps.name: MagiCats Builder
apps.short_description: Build your very own game world in MagiCats Builder – the ultimate sandbox platformer where only your imagination is the limit! Design levels, characters, objects, environments – anything your heart desires – using a simple visual coding engine.

apps.name: Mailbound
apps.short_description: EXPLORE, CONTAIN and FEED a CURSED PC, while what lives inside leaks out into the world around you. Mailbound is a narrative-driven horror game about attempting to uncover a conspiracy and amend your past mistakes.

apps.name: Mansion of Masks
apps.short_description: An invitation. A silver key. A mansion full of very tempting strangers. Step into a woman’s shoes in this lavishly illustrated adult visual novel by Cassie Alexander. Choose your company, explore your desires, and come back for the doors you left unopened.

apps.name: Mega Raiders
apps.short_description: Fight thousands of enemies alongside your friends, grow stronger together, and unlock new characters and weapons. Craft powerful ultimates to destroy bosses or save a fallen friend. Customize your skill tree to match your playstyle, and survive endless hordes with countless build combinations.

apps.name: Midnight Hotel
apps.short_description: Midnight Hotel is a cooperative survival game for multiple players, where you take on the role of staff at a terrifying hotel operating exclusively during the night hours. Check in guests, manage the property, keep the hotel running - and survive until dawn.

apps.name: Military Waifu
apps.short_description: Military Waifu is a puzzle game about charming girls in military uniforms and the atmosphere of army life. Complete 30 levels, unlock stylish illustrations of military waifus, and save all the images in your personal gallery in high quality.

apps.name: Mind of the Midwest
apps.short_description: Killing cults in the Midwest.

apps.name: Minerva Rising
apps.short_description: Expand deeper, grow production, and maintain trust as you fight to save the last humans on Earth—whether they like it or not. You, their systems AI, know best. But when food runs low and the air thickens, it’ll take more than sweet words to keep them from shutting you off for good.

apps.name: Mining to Riches!
apps.short_description: Dig it, smelt it, sell it, and become a Mining Magnate! Bearded minimi miners chip away at sparkling crystal ore while carts haul it, furnaces melt it and your shop sells it. Start as a New Stall and climb all the way to Mining Magnate in this cozy one-screen mining incremental.

apps.name: MISTWAKE
apps.short_description: Shipwrecked on a fogbound island, survive through cards, crafting and careful travel. Restore emergency communications, reopen the old harbor and mark a safe channel. Reach the rescue boat alive within the pickup window.

apps.name: Monster Girl Tactics: Oubliette
apps.short_description: A dark romance SRPG. Pledge your life to feisty and unhinged monstergirls, then defeat your foes using careful positioning and strategical wit. From the downtrodden rise a revolting mafia; join them in a wild hunt for power, revenge, change... and love.

apps.name: Monster League Baseball
apps.short_description: In Monster League Baseball, manage a team of creatures and critters by optimizing your layout, upgrading stats, and slugging out to score as many runs as possible. Monster League Baseball puts YOU in control of your own team of nine.

apps.name: MORS
apps.short_description: Every evening the note said tomorrow, for fifty years, and every morning the tree was still there. So Vladimir and Estragon cut it down, built a rocket from it, an oil drum and a painted can, and flew to Mars to build a factory: mining, belts, machines. Godot, presumably, is late.

apps.name: Multi Miner Madness
apps.short_description: A mining party game for up to four players. Drill for ore, haul it up and sell it, then spend the money on bigger drills, bombs and rams. Play on one screen with friends on the couch, or online through Steam.

apps.name: My Days at Starstruck Academy
apps.short_description:
Re-experience your senior year, but as the only human at an alien high school! 
Make the wrong choices, find some friends, fall in love, and fight to survive in the battlefield of teenage temperament!

apps.name: My General
apps.short_description: The Emperor has passed and the four isles are at war. Buy an army, put it on a hill and make it hold, or not! Hand drawn medieval battles with 26 factions, cavalry charges, pike walls and armies that run when they lose their nerve. Become whom they call My General now!

apps.name: My Girl Loves Handcuffs
apps.short_description: A guy. A girl. A pair of handcuffs. And a lot of kinky sex.

apps.name: Mythical Whalers
apps.short_description: Set sail in the shrouded seas. A procedurally generated world where each voyage is unique. Captain a crew of mythical races to face monstrous leviathans and gain status with cunning factions.

apps.name: Neo Junk City
apps.short_description: Sinister tides are rising in the Drowned City. Dive into a Point and Click action-RPG with fast-paced shoot-outs and retro arcade racing. Uncover the truth behind a murder you don't remember committing!

apps.name: Newborn
apps.short_description: Newborn is a 3D online fantasy RPG for Windows where every journey begwins at the very start of a life. Create a character, step into the medieval town of Rokento, and set out across a living continent of desert dunes, frozen glaciers, misty marshlands, open seas and far-off islands.

apps.name: No;Heaven
apps.short_description: No;Heaven is a short, single-player FPS featuring anime-style characters and gritty visuals reminiscent of early 2000s games. A young woman who has lost everything, including those she held dear, takes up arms. Witness where her path of revenge leads.

apps.name: Not Waste Wood
apps.short_description: Forge your path in True Men Ascend, a dark fantasy action RPG with cultivation-inspired progression. Choose from 20 classes, hunt loot, master relics and Inner Arts, and challenge dungeons and bosses solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

apps.name: Noël macabre
apps.short_description: Noël macabre is a narrative-driven horror FPS that blends dark comedy with cosmic horror. Play as Georges, a police officer forced to return to work on Christmas Eve. Investigate a mysterious threat and save those who can still be saved. Will you see your duty through to the end?

apps.name: Nullnest
apps.short_description: Defend the Core in this incremental tower defense. Survive relentless enemy waves, unlock new abilities, and collect gems of different rarities that completely transform each run. Experiment with endless combinations and create unique strategies to overcome ever-growing challenges.

apps.name: Oaklands: Beyond
apps.short_description: Chop trees, mine rocks, collect resources, earn money, and build anything you can imagine in a vast open world. Claim land, explore with friends, and make the world of Oaklands yours.

apps.name: OIL & HORROR
apps.short_description: A high-risk high-reward oil prospecting survival game. Strategically choose a sector and depth to drill. Strike oil or abandon the hole. Survive ice spikes, spores, mutant monsters and a vengeful Warlok. Defend yourself with your trusty machine gun and grenade launcher, and strike it rich!

apps.name: Oinkenomics
apps.short_description: What if you took finance and tower defense, and combined them? Well, this is Oinkenomics, where you create pig towers, trade stocks, take loans, and mine bitcoin to defend your piggy bank. Defend against various enemies, bulls, bears, and the powerful black swan.

apps.name: On The Come Up
apps.short_description: Start small and work your way up in On The Come Up, a co-op crime game about making money, stealing cars, dodging police, and building a home for your crew. Follow a story that gets personal, or take a break from the missions and see what you can get away with around the city.

apps.name: One Last Spin
apps.short_description: Board a train that takes you from one cursed game to the next. Every room brings a different challenge in this first-person incremental horror game. Start with little, transform your machines one upgrade at a time, and rely on luck and blood pacts to reach the next stop.

apps.name: Online Obsession
apps.short_description: Have you ever had an online friend? What if you were to meet them in real life? Can you be sure that nothing will go wrong? Find out in this horribly adorable experience.

apps.name: Ossuvar
apps.short_description: 96 spells. 8 schools of magic. Soak a pack of demons and let lightning tear through them, or spend your own life to unleash three waves of fire. Shape Isquara’s build with 500 blessings across the paths of Heaven and Hell, then fight alongside Tess through 10 maps in this isometric action RPG.

apps.name: Patience Is Key
apps.short_description: Patience Is Key is a classic challenging 2D platformer game in which you will encounter difficult and tricky levels that will test your patience as the title suggests, and make you think about better solutions on passing the levels.

apps.name: Pay To Die
apps.short_description: “One more room, then we’re out.” You’ve got the package. The loot next door might cover the bill. Get to the elevator and hold off the horde until the doors open. Pay To Die is a third-person survival extraction game for up to four players in online co-op.

apps.name: Peer Into The Void
apps.short_description: Catch what moved. The moves get smaller and smaller. Test your perception.

apps.name: Perfect Thog
Phantask
apps.short_description: Devil May Cry with rent due. Vick is a street mage who swaps bodies mid-combo and kills other people's nightmares for thirty bucks a job. Claire is the elite's golden girl she can't stand — and you play her too. The final form isn't a button: you earn it by not getting hit. Rent's due on the 10th.

apps.name: Polygrounds
apps.short_description: Master rally-car physics in a neon 2D roguelite physics shooter. Navigate procedural vector dungeons, survive claustrophobic ambushes, face interesting foes, pick new guns, and draft run-defining cards. Will you build a game breaking deck or face an untimely end?

apps.name: Prison Queen
apps.short_description: In a world ruled by sharp tongues, one slip of the lip lands young Odette behind bars. Steal words from your fellow inmates, chain them into razor-sharp sentences, and talk your way up the prison food chain. Here, every sentence is a weapon.

apps.name: Psst!
apps.short_description: Sit down with friends, give a few hints, and try not to give your secret away. In this party game, close guesses earn you points, but an exact answer knocks you out. Play as cats across five word-game modes, online with friends or solo with bots.

apps.name: Psycho Frogo
apps.short_description: Psycho Frogo is a fast, addictive “learn the line” speed-runner. Your mission is simple: figure out the best path, then speed run the best path. Every level is designed with the optimal route - work it out to beat the clock and unlock the next level.

apps.name: Pulse Check
apps.short_description: Pulse Check is a social deduction game where Nurses prepare IV bags, deliver meals, and keep patients stable. Fake Nurses sneak patients beer, microwave blood, and make medical decisions best left unexplained.

apps.name: Pulse Citadel
apps.short_description: An incremental defense game where each run funds your next upgrade. The Citadel shoots automatically. Pick what to research, then time your abilities to keep it alive.

apps.name: Pyramid Party
apps.short_description: Turn desert sand into a towering pyramid, one brick at a time. Dig, craft sandstone, upgrade your outpost and enlist helpful robots. Build solo or with friends, watch your thirst and fend off mischievous skeletons.

apps.name: Quasar
apps.short_description: Quasar is a "Bullet Hell Space Opera" with endless levels and upgrades for your ship. You'll fight against squadrons of enemy ships, even battling entire armadas, with bosses appearing occasionally during Survival mode.

apps.name: Qumaq
apps.short_description: A Survival-Horror-Action story from Alaskan creatives CakeNeq Games and Don Rearden.  Survive the strange creatures that call Quarrel Island home. Uncover the deep history. Look for an escape. Find your new community.

apps.name: Ragga-Dagga
apps.short_description: An Action Roguelite where Aggressive Play is Rewarded Handsomely! Explore a Non-Euclidean Dungeon filled with hidden mysteries in this oh so cute adventure about a catling and his sentient floating sword!

apps.name: RATS
apps.short_description: Hide from your friends in the dark. Find the parts, feed the terminal and get out, while one or two of them hunt you by sound as one of nine killers. No markers, no waypoints: only your torch, your phone and what you hear.

apps.name: Ravenford: The Last Raven Warden
apps.short_description: Ravenford: The Last Raven Warden is a painterly dark fantasy beat 'em up. Fight through twelve cursed chapters as the last warden, chain sword combos and fiery spells, move between lanes, upgrade your blade and armor, and face monstrous bosses to free a land swallowed by night.

apps.name: RECLOCK
apps.short_description:
Armed with a neural implant that rewinds time, CIA operative Wolf Cross must save civilization from an eco-terrorist mastermind wielding future technology.

As Wolf, use your RECLOCK ability to outflank enemies, resurrect allies, solve physics puzzles, and perform stunts while time runs in reverse.

apps.name: Resident Evil 7 Teaser: Beginning Hour
apps.short_description:
You wake up alone on the floor of an abandoned farmhouse. Daylight is quickly fading. You must find a way out.

A thrilling horror experience for the five senses. This full model change to the "Isolated View", and photorealistic graphics of RE Engine mark a new beginning for survival horror. Enter a terrifyingly new world of horror and survive.

apps.name: RETROLL
apps.short_description: Race a marble down endless generated courses under a neon sky. Find a course you love, share its code, and your friends race the same one.

apps.name: Roger Running Tree Wages War Against God
apps.short_description: Roger running tree was enjoying his afternoon and kind bud, when he noticed some commotion outside. Upon investigation, Roger finds his home ravaged by an unknown enemy: the white man. By the grace of the spirits, the village elder tasked their greatest warrior, Roger, to rid their land of strife.

apps.name: Roller Derby Manager
apps.short_description: Lead your squad to glory in the definitive modern flat track roller derby simulation. Customize skaters, train skills, and call off the jam in real-time, top-down tactical matches. From local bouts to tournament trophies, can you manage your way to the top?

apps.name: Run and Fun
apps.short_description: Run, compete for the best spots, use abilities, and seize every opportunity in RUN AND FUN, a competitive party game where each arena turns the race for the highest score into a different kind of chaos. Play solo or with up to 4 players, locally or online.

apps.name: Ruthenium Smash & Grab
apps.short_description: Shoot the asteroids until they're small enough to collect. If anything hits the tail of asteroids you've collected, you lose them. Don't lose so many. Lose less. *Fewer.

apps.name: Samurai Love Ballad Song of Radiance
apps.short_description:
In the war-torn Sengoku Era.
To save your brother's life, you go to serve at the castle.
But...who would await you there but the samurai who would stop at nothing to rule Japan...!
Though both of you know death is waiting...

The love stories that will turn the tides of history...all start with you!

apps.name: Shadow Mist Idle
apps.short_description: "Shadow Mist Idle" is a placeable pixel-style dark loot-grinding game. Build your skills through selectable talents and a vast array of unique equipment, and vanquish the hordes of enemies that come your way.

apps.name: SHROOMY ISLAND
apps.short_description: Shroomy Island is a desktop tower defense idle game. Critters automatically gather, craft, build, and patrol, help them run their village and fend off the evil mushroom monsters. Slowly expand and decorate your village, and collect different critters to keep you company while you work or study!

apps.name: Silent Still 3
apps.short_description: Silent Still 3 is a first-person psychological horror experience focused on sleep paralysis, limited movement, and environmental tension. Fear builds slowly through silence, observation, subtle audio cues, and realistic spaces, creating a lasting sense of unease as control gradually slips away.

apps.name: Silkgrove
apps.short_description: Become a Restorer in Silkgrove. Use your toolkit to scavenge resources, repair, build, craft, and help rebuild communities in this solarpunk world. Upgrade & manage your mobile home, drive across regions, and restore balance to this post-apocalyptic world.

apps.name: Sincerely, Your Diary
apps.short_description: A quiet autumn evening in a small seaside town. The soft flicker of a monitor, drizzle outside, and your favorite tracks playing in your headphones. A simple "hi" from a stranger breaks the quiet. What starts as a chat to pass the time becomes a fragile thread connecting two very different worlds...

apps.name: Six Slashes
apps.short_description: This is a first-person fast-paced action game with simple, satisfying gameplay. Play as a cybernetically enhanced warrior who inherits a former commander’s memory disk—fight through enemies while memories resurface.

apps.name: Slash Dash
apps.short_description: Fight your way through difficult levels with dangerous enemies in this fast paced 2D action bullet hell game.

apps.name: Slay The Demon Queen Super Sexy Supreme
apps.short_description: A fantasy action roguelite with exciting rewards! Fight endless demon hordes, build devastating combos, and unlock an arsenal of weapons! Then head back to camp, meet your lovely companions, and discover just how rewarding earning their affection can be.

apps.name: Sleepwalkers
apps.short_description: Bloodthirsty creatures are destroying your life and the lives of your loved ones. Grab your weapon, fight them, and uncover the secrets of a mysterious experiment that brings all your deepest fears to the surface.

apps.name: Slime Attack
apps.short_description: Slime Attack is an incremental action game where you defeat hordes of enemies in dungeons, gather resources, and grow stronger. Unlock new features and skills, upgrade your equipment, and become even more powerful. Challenge new dungeons and mighty bosses as you progress.

apps.name: Slip Angle
apps.short_description: Arcade drift racing where being sideways is almost mandatory! Find the perfect balance between speed and angle to clear objectives and slide your way through multiple game modes - enjoy the drift flow state or challenge yourself to be one of the best, the choice is yours.

apps.name: Smoke Em If You Got Em
apps.short_description: Smoke Em If You Got Em (SEIYGE) is a PvPvE tactical VR FPS shooter with vehicles, to include a functioning C130 Gunship.  Up to 3 teams battle over different maps to hold a trophy for 3 minutes to win the match.  SEIYGE includes weapon attachments, revives and a Zombie mode for each map.

apps.name: Snakez Arena
apps.short_description: Snakez Arena is a 2.5D platformer shooter with it's unique movement, projectile characteristics and includes multiple game modes! Download now to try out the bulllet hell!

apps.name: Snowmageddon
apps.short_description: Roll a tiny snowball down cozy winter mountains and grow it into an unstoppable avalanche. Flatten flowers, forests, Christmas markets and whole cities, chain combos and watch the damage bill soar. A relaxing arcade wrecking ride for long winter nights.

apps.name: SOLITUDE: Echoes from the Bloodline
apps.short_description: The bloodline endures in this sci-fi action horror experience. Enter a digital temple built of the empire's gravest and most corrupted memories as you race against a robotic tech cult bent on your demise to restore the empire's echoed memories.

apps.name: Sort The Lot
apps.short_description: A cozy relaxing game about sorting 298 vehicles in an impound lot! Earn parking points, upgrade your abilities, unlock new areas, and park every vehicle!

apps.name: Sort The Pandas
apps.short_description: Thousands of pandas, two amazing worlds and one mission – put everything perfectly in place! Over 5,000 pandas are waiting for you in a shop full of shelves and a lush bamboo grove. Every panda you place brings you closer to perfect order. Level up your skills and see how many pandas you can sort!

apps.name: Soryou
apps.short_description: Explore an unseen world through sound as a blind girl. An ASMR × Horror × Emotional Journey. Immerse yourself in a world where comfort and fear intertwine, brought to life through 3D spatial audio.

apps.name: Soulcery: Deck of Shadows
apps.short_description:
A spell-slinging hack-and-slash action roguelite. 
Devour enemies and seal their abilities into cards.  
Draw cards to switch spells and chain them together to destroy everything in your path!

apps.name: SOVOK: Battle Royale
apps.short_description: A Soviet-themed battle royale packed with Russian memes. Loot up, squad up, and fit your glove with cassettes to blind enemies, punch through thin walls, and heal teammates. Sweep away the competition in SOVOK!

apps.name: Space Burger
apps.short_description: Run a burger joint in zero gravity with your friends. Jetpack around a tiny spaceship, stack floating burgers, feed chatty aliens and keep the place in one piece while meteors, fires and hull breaches tear it apart.

apps.name: Spaceship Merchant Phouli
apps.short_description: Salvage wrecks, weld neon modular parts onto your freighter, and trade at named worlds across Sol, Orion, and Andromeda.

apps.name: Split Tempo
apps.short_description: A twin-stick rhythm game for your own music, with a hand-charted EP included. Each stick flies its own comet: flick into gates, ride traces through the vocals, and slam them together on the big hits. Tired of grinding? Relax by raising Punkos in Punko Park

apps.name: Spooky House Maker
apps.short_description: Build your own haunted house and scare friends and players worldwide! In Spooky House Maker, mix and match rooms, props, and spooky tricks. Fulfill ghosts' requests, explore other players' creations, or control the scares yourself in Manager Mode!

apps.name: Staatio
apps.short_description:
Real-time territory conquest. Drag to send troops, swallow the map region by
region, forge alliances and break them. Play solo against bots or invite friends
over Steam or LAN.

apps.name: STAR WARS™: The Old Republic™ - Public Test Server
apps.short_description: STAR WARS™: The Old Republic™ is a free-to-play MMORPG that puts you at the center of your own story-driven saga. Play as a Jedi, Sith, Bounty Hunter, or one of many other iconic STAR WARS roles in the galaxy far, far away over three thousand years before the classic films.

apps.name: Starry Paws
apps.short_description: Lost animals have stopped on the road. Guide them to the stars with the crow.

apps.name: Station KHE-7
apps.short_description: Arm your ship, repair your home station, and face vast hordes of vassals serving hostile powers. Every cell counts. Every component can be your key to victory or the harbinger of your downfall. In this roguelite, you decide what your enemies learn to fear.

apps.name: Stone & Stout
apps.short_description: It takes 48 dwarves to dig 14 meters of granite in a day. Six of them dig. In this cutaway idle management game, keep the beer flowing, the mugs clean, the lanterns lit and the rubble moving, and lead your company ever deeper beneath a bottomless mountain.

apps.name: straywild
apps.short_description: Fish, catch bugs, dig for clams, and paint the world in Straywild, a relaxed solo or online multiplayer hangout. Create your own animal character, explore generated islands in changing weather, fill your logbook, and upgrade your home that travels with you!

apps.name: Summer, Youth, and Baseball
apps.short_description: A short incremental baseball game: hit the ball, collect cheers, reach the ending.

apps.name: Super Awesome Mega Roadtrip (Ultra-Fantastic, Even, Yo)
apps.short_description: Embark on a surreal road trip where the destinations disappear once you leave. Take your time, explore while you can, meet a variety of strange drifters… and try not to break too many rules. Your Odyssey awaits…

apps.name: Super Meat Boy Again+
apps.short_description: Super Meat Boy Again + is a tough as nails platformer originally released in 2010. This version is just like the original Super Meat Boy game but with new art, music, cutscenes, levels, secrets and unlockables...new EVERYTHING. Play it for the first time, or play it AGAIN for the first time.

apps.name: Sylvestar Sleuth: Space Mystery
apps.short_description:
IN THE YEAR 1992...
Crime isn't quite as big of a deal, but mysteries sure are.
Sylvestar Sleuth follows a deep case assigned to the best space detective this side of the galaxy, Sylvestar Slooth.
Help her find some missing people, and make sure no more go missing!

apps.name: The Blood Knight: Episode Dawn
apps.short_description: Defeat, Devour, and Forge. The Blood Knight is a Turn-Based JRPG inspired by the classics. Guide Zeno Trillion, a boy who can turn objects into something more. Master unique skills and equipment, unleash Zeno's Critical Skills, and lead companions through a journey full of twists and turns.

apps.name: The Curse of the Horny Ghost
apps.short_description: You arrive at a cursed island with three friends, but a very horny ghost woman lives there who wants to use you as toys. Live different supernatural sex stories and find out how to break the island's curse... or stay and belong to the ghost forever.

apps.name: The Escapists 3
apps.short_description: Plan ridiculous prison breaks, outsmart the guards and escape your way in The Escapists 3. Craft, sneak, fight and improvise through a new 3D prison sandbox, alone or with friends. Just remember to make roll call.

apps.name: The Horde Always Wins
apps.short_description: An idle auto-shooter where your cube fights an endless horde on its own. Build your weapon from the parts the swarm drops, wire runes into combos, and trade max HP for permanent perks every time you die. The horde always wins. Push it further.

apps.name: The Last Expedition
apps.short_description: A co-op survival horror expedition through a silent 1936 countryside. Crew a colossal land crawler, scavenge fuel, food and ammunition, keep the machine alive and survive the infected as you carry a living captive north. Every noise you make draws them closer.

apps.name: The Seven Spells Of Destruction
apps.short_description: Remember those adventure gamebooks where every decision could lead to treasure, or a particularly unpleasant death? Welcome to Cryptillia. A vast multiplayer fantasy world where thousands of locations await you, and your next decision might just be your last. Bring your imagination. You'll need it.

apps.name: Tiara
apps.short_description: Tiara is an exploration-focused narrative game where you play through days (and dream through nights) to uncover the story of Tiara's life.

apps.name: Tidy Pills
apps.short_description: Step behind the counter of a quiet little pharmacy and bring order to its shelves. Sort, stack and arrange medicines one box at a time in this cozy organizing game. No timers, no pressure, just the simple joy of a perfectly tidy shelf.

apps.name: Tidy Up The Christmas Shop
apps.short_description: Tidy up a cozy Christmas shop solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op! Find, carry and sort thousands of festive objects across 765 item types. Upgrade your gift sack, unlock a little Christmas magic, and bring order to the holiday chaos, one shelf at a time.

apps.name: Tidy Up the Grocery Warehouse
apps.short_description: One partner snapped, and Ultra Fresh Food needs your help. About 3,000 products hit the floor. Restore order to the grocery warehouse with handy abilities or your own two hands, then pick and pack orders until the shelves are empty.

apps.name: TILELIA
apps.short_description: Collect cards, place buildings, and forge your own army in this roguelite auto-battler. Combine units, spells, and relics from different factions. Make the most of limited space and gold, and discover new combinations to overcome each battle.

apps.name: Tilted Slammers
apps.short_description: A team arena brawler where walls are the only way to knock someone out. Slam rivals into your walls until one breaks, steal the gem from their vault, and keep yours. 1v1 or 2v2, on the couch or online with rollback netcode.

apps.name: TinyWind
apps.short_description: A pixel pirate roguelite with real sailing and naval combat in short runs. Hand-rolled wind physics, procedural islands, mythic treasure and rare sea companions. Liberate British, Spanish and Dutch waters, hold Tortuga against both Crowns, or duel other captains in ranked PvP.

apps.name: Train Station Staff Simulator
apps.short_description: First-person sim: work at a small, new one-line station in Japan. Open up at dawn, sort out trouble at the gates, announce delays, hit the emergency stop if someone falls onto the tracks: over 60 kinds of real station work. Even with a subway line, you're one person sharing the work with your crew.

apps.name: Trash Panda Bonanza
apps.short_description: Adopt a mischievous raccoon that lives right on your desktop. Recycle junk into coins, unlock cosmetics through mystery boxes, pick up randomly appearing junk, and even pet your new raccoon buddy!

apps.name: Trivia Fantasy
apps.short_description:
TRIVIA FANTASY is a trivia-based adventure with RPG progression. 
Crawl your way through a decayed tower filled with forgotten knowledge and defeat the dying deity that that awaits at the summit!

apps.name: Twenty Till Him
apps.short_description: Kidnapped by a serial killer. Twenty seconds per room. Four ways out, and only one lets you live. Read the dust, the draft, the blood and the silence, then choose before the masked old man comes back. One mistake and you wake up tied in the first room again. 100 rooms. One house. No happy ending.

apps.name: Unstoppable Arrow
apps.short_description: Draw your bow and wield fire and frost in this single-player VR action game. Physically slot runes to shape your abilities, then face advancing enemies in torchlit dungeons. Requires a PC VR headset and tracked controllers.

apps.name: Until You’re Better
apps.short_description: A first-person ASMR game in a wellness center in orbit. Every real day your nurse gives you a check-up: follow her light, guess sounds with your eyes closed, tell her which ear a sound was in. Progress your treatment to unlock new activities and more of the center. No ending, only unwinding.

apps.name: UwUbUwU
apps.short_description: UwUbUwU is a small cozy puzzle game based on a simple idea: What if you took classic Snake but inverted the goal and made it so you have to form a loop by eating your own tail.

apps.name: Valkyrie Match
apps.short_description: Gather the star-gems that can restore the fallen sky citadel. Match gems, awaken your Valkyrie cards, and outplay your rival turn by turn in this fantasy puzzle card battler.

apps.name: Vampirelands
apps.short_description: Play an exciting top-down action RPG and become an unbeatable Night Hunter. You will have to fight alone or with friends, unlocking new abilities and obtaining unique weapons and equipment from the generated loot. Be a true hero and defeat the darkness in this thrilling world!

apps.name: Visual Novel
apps.short_description: New Capybara, 1933. Private investigator Sam Malone and his assistant, Tommy, take on a case to find a missing wooden leg that contains a secret ledger. A branching noir detective story infused with dark humor, where any choice could be your last.

apps.name: Vortex Force
apps.short_description: Control a growing force of heroes in this tactical RPG where retro-style combat meets modern, roguelike design. Jump to new alien worlds as you gather allies and resources to combat a mysterious threat to the galaxy!

apps.name: Wacky Drivers
apps.short_description: A chaotic top-down racer where drifting, boosting, and power-ups turn every race into pure madness! Compete in Grand Prix, Arcade, and Time Attack modes across 16 wild stages. Collect cars, use power-ups, and master every track in this fast, fun, and unpredictable arcade racer!

apps.name: Warheads vs Wizards
apps.short_description: Lead a small modern army against a mind-controlled medieval horde of 100,000+ knights, adventurers, wizards and the risen dead. Aim rifles and RPGs, then upgrade and deploy MG nests, flamethrowers, tanks, howitzers, gunships, jet strikes and a lot more. Overwhelmed? Call in the tactical warhead.

apps.name: Wildcat
apps.short_description: Wildcat is a top-down fast-paced roguelite dungeon crawler featuring powerful witchcraft and intense boss fights. Discover hundreds of items, combine them to master the elements, defeat guardians and rival witches, then rescue the lost cats!

apps.name: With flowers, fringe of fondness
apps.short_description: Life is suffocating. Almost crushed by the authority known as "normal." Tuyu, who spends their days asking themself, "Do I have a place in this society?", meets a certain friend at university. Those living on the margins find joy, suffer in their insignificant days—and attempt to resist the world.

apps.name: Wizard Mayhem
apps.short_description: Wizard duels with a comic look. Aim every spell yourself, dodge at the last second and fire off your ultimate before the other guy does. Five wizards, four arenas, duels and knockout tournaments against bots or online against a friend. A co-op roguelike joins during Early Access.

apps.name: Worldtree Nexus
apps.short_description: A sort of fancy text-adventure where you explore various worlds to do quests, train skills, craft items, play minigames, and more.

apps.name: WRECKRUN RACING
apps.short_description: Free arcade racing with competitive AI, 14 race maps, a rally stage and a sandbox. Race five rivals, beat the clock and hold the perfect line. Keyboard, gamepad and steering wheel supported. A high school graduation project.

apps.name: xVR
apps.short_description: An expansive nature simulation experience for VR and desktop, to get lost in a virtual recreation of a "third place".

apps.name: Yarn-Ball!
apps.short_description: Yarn-Ball! is a multiplayer sandbox game where you can create & explore various worlds as a silly cat!!! :3

apps.name: Zombie Apocalypse Together
apps.short_description: Fight zombies, scavenge cities, explore the wild, hunt, craft and build a base in a world that is new every game. Start with nothing and survive with up to 3 friends. Every seventh night, the Blood Moon brings the horde to your walls.

apps.name: Zombie Outbreak - Co-Op Edition
apps.short_description: Survive with your allies with up to 4-Player Online Co-Op survival and try to resist death in classic round-based zombies. Can you survive the zombie outbreak?

apps.name: いるかのいるまち -Isolation Dolphin Tank-
apps.short_description: You fall asleep on the train home and wake at an unfamiliar station: Cetacea City, a town lost in endless night beneath two hazy moons. Your only clue is a dolphin hymn heard in a faint dream. Talk with its curious residents and gather fragments of lost memories in this dreamy, hypnotic adventure.

apps.name: すずちな水族館 / Suzuchina Aquarium
apps.short_description:
Exit 8-style anomaly game in an aquarium
You find yourself trapped in an infinitely looping aquarium. Carefully observe your surroundings, detect anomalies, and find a way to escape.

apps.name: ガメツキキングダム ～ワルポンたちの王さま争奪戦～
apps.short_description: Steal. Betray. Become King! Gametsuki Kingdom: The Great Crown Grab! is a competitive board-game RPG in development for Steam. Designed for up to four players, it combines sugoroku-style movement, character growth, betrayal and comebacks in a contest for the crown.

apps.name: デモンズゲート with サバゲでGo!
apps.short_description:
Enjoy character development. Over 100 character slots. 
Auto-progression dispatch system. Over 50 stages. 
Auto-progression is also possible.
`tactical role‑playing game (tactical RPG)`
`strategy RPG (SRPG)`
`grid‑based turn‑based tactics game`
`Japanese turn‑based tactical RPG series`

apps.name: 一撇 One Stroke Short
apps.short_description: There's a Chinese saying for a job that hasn't begun: the character is still one stroke short. You're the missing stroke in this puzzle adventure. Knock a character out of a sentence to clear the way, then play the four tones of Mandarin to make a path where there wasn't one.

apps.name: 世界樹と護符の約束
apps.short_description: Explore the Worldtree, gather materials, craft Omamori, and venture deeper. Navigate randomly changing paths, face rising Worldtree Pressure, and continue your adventure even after defeat. Strengthen your party, upgrade equipment, and uncover the secrets of the Worldtree in this fantasy RPG.

apps.name: 偽人鳥ゲーム -ニセペンギンゲーム-
apps.short_description: A certain streamer's fan meeting. Ten men and women are trapped on a luxury cruise ship. And the nightmare 'death game' begins—Collect notes through investigation, use deduction and voting to 'catch the shark'! A mid-length mystery ADV where bad endings are unavoidable.

apps.name: 奶蛙再爱我一次
apps.short_description: A weekend AI experiment created a milk frog that can't be deleted. It begs you to keep it, promises to purge the viruses — so you go live and mow down a neon computer world, while it laughs and searches for its real "mother".

apps.name: 循环扫雷
apps.short_description: Tired of traditional Minesweeper? Try Loop Minesweeper! Familiar rules, but the board never ends. Had enough of flat boards? Rotate a sphere and sweep mines in 3D. Want something stranger? Try negatively curved space on a Poincaré disk. Super cool.

apps.name: 敲敲小镇：桌面锻造物语
apps.short_description: Type to mine, smelt, and forge gear with random affixes. Welcome residents, battle monsters and village trials. Stronger residents mean faster automated production. Start with one blacksmith shop and grow your town!

apps.name: 東京蜃気楼
apps.short_description: A Story of a Shrine Maiden Who Purifies a Dead Tokyo by Choosing Her Path Through Solitude

apps.name: 渊海群星：深海文明建设
apps.short_description: Start with kelp and a settler in an icebound abyss. Gather, build, assign jobs, and survive the seasons. Research through ten eras, shape society, grow in faith, build wonders. Break the ice, explore stars, build megastructures. Grow a deep-sea civilization with idle play, challenges, and Prestige.

apps.name: 湖边的山香果-Cinnamomum
apps.short_description: Scenes from dreams and people already passed away appear in reality. What secret lies behind it all? The game contains 70,000 characters and 20 CG. You need to click on the locations shown as explorable each day on the map. Please read it like novel. The playtime is about two hours.

apps.name: 澱 —— 夜番
apps.short_description: Your childhood friend Saichi was swept away by the river; this morning his body surfaced. By custom, the one who was with him keeps the vigil. Keep the lamp lit, stay by his side, keep your eyes shut, and drive off what comes by sound alone.

apps.name: 烈焰觉醒之战神传奇
apps.short_description: 一款以南宋末年为舞台的 3D暗黑武侠MMORPG。它没有把“侠”字挂在嘴边当装饰，而是把你丢进一个金国“暗棋”死士、南疆五仙教与南宋武林多方绞杀的乱世里，让你用刀、枪、剑、镰四种兵器，从一场灭门血案开始，一路杀到盟主之位。没有花哨的转职树，没有温吞的成长曲线，你要做的只有一件事：用最趁手的兵器，在这个不讲道理的时代里活下来，然后让所有人记住你的名字。

apps.name: 研究生病院
apps.short_description: A visual novel set in the modern or near-future era. You play as a male protagonist struggling with psychological trauma after graduate school, as he reconnects with three heroines. Through player choices, you will develop relationships, and uncover the past of each character.

apps.name: 这不是罗马
apps.short_description:
“All roads lead to Rome, but the tolls are strictly non-refundable.”

Wrapped in the parchment of ancient bureaucracy, Meet the Rome is a satirical, choice-driven narrative game.

apps.name: 送り火のうた
apps.short_description: Escort a sacred festival float through the streets of night Kyoto during Obon. Play as Uta, fight off waves of spirits in fast action combat, and build your power with roguelite cards and weapons in this tower-defense action roguelite with a Japanese dark-fantasy mood.

apps.name: 鍛冶屋は今日も忙しい
apps.short_description: What will your hammer forge next? Run a blacksmith shop in this incremental game where each weapon's name, rarity, and value depend on a random mix of materials and modifiers. Mine ore, stock your shelves, and turn failed pieces into upgrades. Put robots to work and aim for 5 million gold!

apps.name: 麻将：百相牌
apps.short_description: Mahjong: Bai Xiang Pai is a single-player roguelite deckbuilder. Play 1–5 of 14 Mahjong tiles to form Pairs, Chows, Pungs or Kongs, then multiply Chips to beat each target. Reshape your deck, collect Edicts, items and rule-changing Mask Cards, and chase special Self-Draw hands and explosive combos.

apps.name: 삼국 객잔
apps.short_description: A Three Kingdoms strategy auto battler with solo campaigns and online co-op. Recruit units, build formations, and grow your army. Free to play with optional paid content. Korean interface.

apps.name: Bounce On 2: Drallo's Demise Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The soundtrack for Bounce On 2: Drallo's Demise in high quality MP3.

apps.name: Emerald Space Courier Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Tune into Emerald Space FM with the official soundtrack for Emerald Space Courier! 16 high-energy tracks combining nostalgic 8/16-bit sound chips, fast-paced drum & bass, and darksynth procedurally generated by ShortPelt. Includes both 320kbps MP3 and lossless FLAC formats.

apps.name: Infested DX Soundtrack
apps.short_description:
The official soundtrack to Infested DX.



Music by Orie Falconer

Original Game by GrahfMetal and Komi Games Inc.

Album Art by David Lopez

apps.name: Mudheim Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The complete 18-track original soundtrack to Mudheim. Featuring atmospheric dwarven instrumentals and lyrical ballads, from the quiet glow of Cavern Ember to the thundering Troll Battle and the haunting voice of Lithodore. Includes both instrumental and vocal versions of key tracks.

apps.name: Sorcerer's Dream - Original Soundtrack
apps.short_description:
Sorcerer's Dream official soundtrack.
Vivid, Sweet, Tense, various melodies amuse you!
Containing 23 tracks in MP3 file format.

apps.name: Syncblade Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The original soundtrack of Syncblade, composed by Daniele Aurigemma (SanielDan), blending a variety of musical genres with the unique sounds of vocal synthesizers.

apps.name: The Talos Principle 2 Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Immerse yourself in the rich, bittersweet world of The Talos Principle 2 with a stunning soundtrack by master composer Damjan Mravunac (Serious Sam, The Talos Principle), with a guest appearance by Chris Christodoulou (Risk of Rain 1 and 2).

apps.name: 永铃回响 Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Revisit the journeys and battles of The Bell Echoes through 49 tracks across two discs. Around 140 minutes of music, including the Chinese vocal song Heaven Rain. Includes all 49 tracks in MP3 and 46 original WAV files.

apps.name: Dota 2 Player Profiles: Invictus Gaming -  BurNIng
apps.short_description: Player profile on BurNIng from Invictus Gaming

apps.name: Dota 2 Player Profiles: OG - ANA
apps.short_description: Player profile on ANA from team OG.
